mainEntity.name: What's the difference between traditional SEO and Generative Engine Optimization for electricians?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO for electricians often involves manual content creation, keyword research, and on-page optimization. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) takes this further by integrating AI tools to automate and scale content generation and optimization. While both aim to improve search rankings, GEO allows for the rapid creation of highly targeted, diverse content that addresses a wider range of customer queries more efficiently. This often results in broader keyword coverage and faster adaptation to search trends, giving electricians a competitive edge.
acceptedAnswer.description: Traditional SEO is manual, while GEO uses AI to automate and scale content creation and optimization for electricians, offering broader coverage and faster adaptation.
